label: Doorbell Integration
info:
Türklingel-Integration: Zigbee2MQTT-Sensor → Dashboard MQTT

Unterstützte Geräte:
- Aqara/SONOFF Kontaktsensor (contact: false = Klingeln)
- Shelly-Taster (input_event.event: 'S')
- Generisch: state=ON oder action=single/press

Umgebungsvariablen:
- DOORBELL_PANELS: kommagetrennte Panel-IDs (z.B. kitchen,wohnzimmer)
- DOORBELL_CAMERA_ID: Kamera-ID die beim Klingeln geöffnet werden kann
- ZIGBEE_SENSOR_NAME: Gerätename in Zigbee2MQTT (im mqtt-in-Node konfigurieren)

name: fn_doorbell_detect
func:
// Detect contact closure: Aqara/SONOFF report contact: false when closed (circuit closed = bell ringing)
// Shelly reports input_event.event: 'S' for single press
const p = msg.payload
const isRing = p.contact === false || p.contact === 'false' ||
               p.action === 'single' || p.action === 'press' ||
               p.input_event?.event === 'S' ||
               p.state === 'ON'
if (!isRing) return null

const panels = (env.get('DOORBELL_PANELS') || 'kitchen').split(',').map(s => s.trim())
const cameraId = env.get('DOORBELL_CAMERA_ID') || 'entrance'

msg.panels = panels
msg.panelIndex = 0
msg.ringPayload = { ts: Date.now(), camera_id: cameraId }
return msg

name: fn_doorbell_publish_loop
Konfiguration
info:
Umgebungsvariablen für diesen Flow (Tab-Eigenschaften → Umgebungsvariablen):

| Variable | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|
| DOORBELL_PANELS | kitchen | Kommagetrennte Panel-IDs |
| DOORBELL_CAMERA_ID | entrance | Kamera-ID für Türklingel-Ansicht |

MQTT-Topic des Sensors im 'Zigbee2MQTT Klingel'-Node anpassen:
  zigbee2mqtt/DOORBELL_SENSOR_NAME

Beispiele:
  zigbee2mqtt/klingel_eingang
  zigbee2mqtt/shelly_taster_tür
